metadata.rationale: This experiment aims to assess the resilience and performance of the Incident Management process under varying conditions of demand and resource availability. By simulating a baseline, a peak load event, and a severe resource constraint, we can identify potential bottlenecks, evaluate service level impacts, and inform capacity planning decisions to ensure effective incident resolution.

report_settings.title: Incident Management Process Simulation Experiment
report_settings.description: Simulating the Incident Management process under baseline, peak load, and resource constrained conditions to assess performance.

scenarios.name: A_Baseline
scenarios.description: Represents the normal operating conditions of the Incident Management process.

scenarios.name: B_Peak_Load
scenarios.description: Tests the system under a significant increase in incident demand, simulating a major outage or incident surge.

scenarios.name: C_Increased_Capacity
scenarios.description: Evaluates whether an additional first-level support resource relieves the bottleneck created by elevated incident demand.
